title: HTTP2: Handle overflow of flow-control window size
description:
The flow-control windows in HTTP/2 are never supposed to exceed
2^31 - 1. Clamp the values. Add expert info. Also add expert
info in several other specification violating situations.

https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9113#name-window_update
